integrity.analytical_basis: Exact Chebyshev secular polynomial and analytic simple-root expansion.
integrity.numerical_basis: 33 direct determinant tests and 195 eigenvalue-width tests using a standalone finite checker.

limitations: Single-particle no-jump spectrum, not a many-body Liouvillian gap.
Asymptotic detuning at fixed finite ring size, hopping, positive loss and fixed mode; no parameter-uniform remainder.
The local eigenvalue branch may not be the globally slowest decay mode.
Prior zero-flux avoiding-mode existence is not presented as original; broader external priority assessment remains open.
title: Quadratic magnetic-flux leakage of dark modes on a singly absorbing quantum ring
